text:
maria: quick health-check for the migration lanes — can owners drop a 1-line status (green/yellow/red) + any blockers? trying to decide whether to widen canary later today.
aj: routing lane: yellow. intermittent auth header drop seen in ~2% of requests after the shim. PR 4821 open, tests flaky on prod-like infra. need an extra pair to review.
taylor: SDK lane: yellow->green if we get the shim patch merged. have a patch in sdk/compat-shim (PR 4890) but CI failing lint. plan: fix lint, cut rc. will need docs note for header fallback.
lina: telemetry: noticed a 0.8% uptick in 401s from eu-west (last 2 hours) that lines up with the auth header issue. traces show missing `x-rw-client` in some requests. adding a dashboard tile now.
maria: thanks. @aj can you add correlation ids to PR notes and link a failing trace sample? we want to triage quickly.
aj: yes, adding sample traces + stack trace. sample log snippet:
```
2025-08-14T13:22:01Z router ERROR trace_id=abc123 req.headers={Authorization:null, "x-rw-client":"sdk-1.2.4"} upstream_error=auth_missing
```
maria: perfect. also need owners for rollout decision: if canary hits <1% error in next 30m we widen to 30%. otherwise hold and roll back.
taylor: heads-up: SDK 1.3.0-rc.2 will include the header fallback and a compatibility note. I can cut the rc once PR 4890 lint is fixed and a reviewer approves. request: please prioritize review from @ravi or @aj.
ravi: I'll take 4890 review now. will run lint fixes and re-run CI. ETA 45m.
deploy-bot: deploy job 7782 started for canary slice 'sdk-canary-3' — rolling 10% traffic (10 pods) — correlation tag: canary-7782.
lina: if we widen, make sure batching config for dedicated pools isn't changed — that could amplify failures. currently batching retains short window for canary.
maria: noted. @eng-runtime please don't change batching until we confirm green.
aj: quick question on deps — does the shim require a new runtime kernel? i thought it's a header fix only.
taylor: shim is header handling + small tokenization guard. no new kernel required. safe for existing runtime. just SDK and shim rollouts.
ravi: lint fixed, force-pushed. CI started. adding reviewers.
maria: excellent. final ask: add a short migration note for support with repro steps and how to revert client-side (old SDK fallback). taylor can you draft and drop in #support once rc is cut?
taylor: yep — will post in #support and tag on the SDK release thread.
deploy-bot: canary health update: slice sdk-canary-3 10% -> errors 0.6% over 10m (rolling) — trending down.
lina: telemetry confirms error rate trending to baseline. traces show auth header present in newly routed requests.
maria: decision: widen to 30% in 15m if rate stays <=1%. @aj @ravi please stand by for rollback window.
aj: standing by. will keep debug logs live for 1h.
ravi: CI passed for 4890, requesting approval from @maria for merge.
maria: approved, merge away. remember to add the migration note and code snippet for local repro.
taylor: merged and cut 1.3.0-rc.2. posting support note now.

support-note (to paste in #support):
- issue: some clients saw missing auth headers after shim rollout (2% of traffic).
- mitigation: upgrade SDK to 1.3.0-rc.2 or rely on header fallback config `X-Compat-Fallback: true`.
- revert: set client header to legacy mode via `RW_SDK_LEGACY=true` env while we rollback server.
- contact: eng-platform oncall.
maria: thanks everyone — updating the migration board with statuses. will post a short postmortem if we need rollback. :thumbsup:
